title: Sign in
intro: See your properties, pay installments and talk to us.
tenantHint: The short name of your developer, for example pk. It is in your invitation email.
forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgotDone: If that address has a portal account, a link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour.
passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
setIntro: Pick a password for your customer portal account.
setDone: Your password is saved. Sign in with it now.
linkMissing: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or ask for a new one.
changeDone: Your password was changed. Please sign in again.

errors.passwordRule: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a digit
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same
